description: This file contains the PHP class 'Returns' which manages sale return operations in the OpenCart admin module, including CRUD (create, read, update, delete) operations for return data and histories.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Handles CRUD operations and data retrieval related to sale returns in the OpenCart admin module.

methods.name: addReturn
methods.description: Inserts a new return record into the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: editReturn
methods.description: Updates an existing return record identified by return_id.

methods.name: deleteReturn
methods.description: Deletes a return record from the database and its associated histories.

methods.name: getReturn
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific return by its ID.

methods.name: getReturns
methods.description: Retrieves a list of returns with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalReturns
methods.description: Returns the total count of returns based on optional filters.

methods.name: getTotalReturnsByReturnStatusId
methods.description: Returns total count of returns with a specific return status ID.

methods.name: getTotalReturnsByReturnReasonId
methods.description: Returns total count of returns with a specific reason ID.

methods.name: getTotalReturnsByReturnActionId
methods.description: Returns total count of returns with a specific action ID.

methods.name: addHistory
methods.description: Adds a history entry for a return, updating its status and logging comments.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history entries associated with a return.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves the history entries for a specific return, with pagination.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Retrieves the list of histories for a specific return ID with pagination support.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts the total number of history entries for a specific return ID.

methods.name: getTotalHistoriesByReturnStatusId
methods.description: Counts the total number of history entries for a specific return status ID.
